main_body: Steel column: a wide rounded capital (rows 8-16), a barred shaft (rows 17-39) and a base drum (rows 40-47).
top_band: Light steel #a4aebb with a #c8d4e0 highlight, rows 9-12 (row 13 is the lip). The cap is wider than the shaft and has rounded ends.
evidence: At x=8 the scan runs: outline at row 8, light top at rows 9-11, highlight at row 12, lip at row 13, then a dark underside at rows 14-16 (L=52). The shaft below is mid and dark steel (L=99 and 52) with light bands. The cap is wider than the shaft, its ends are rounded and it is 4 rows of clearly lighter tone. That reads as a plate-style cap, not the red flat band. The base repeats the same construction. It is borderline but acceptable.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 8 distinct colours and 8 colours per tile, against 38-40 distinct colours and 17-20 per tile in the references. 95% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, which gives the near-black sticker outline (the references are 1% and 33%). The surfaces are made of a few flat tones with regular highlight bars and almost no grain or per-element shading, so the piece is thinner and flatter than the references.
